description: Update a PostHog feature flag by ID.

active.description: Optional new active state: true activates the flag, false deactivates it.

flag_id.description: The ID of the PostHog feature flag to update.

name.description: Optional new human-readable name for the flag; omitted fields are left unchanged.

project_id.description: Optional ID of the PostHog project the flag belongs to; when omitted, the POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID environment fallback is used.

name: update_feature_flag
